inputs.name: toolName
inputs.description: Name of the tool that just ran.

inputs.name: parameters
inputs.description: The arguments the tool was called with.

outputs.name: modifiedResult
outputs.description: Replacement result handed to the model. Leave empty to keep the original.

outputs.name: additionalContext
outputs.description: Extra text passed to the model alongside the result.

outputs.name: suppressOutput
outputs.description: Set to true to hide this tool's output from the user.
